title: EMPLOYEE RAISE FORM
footer: Active Alarm Company, Inc. | Employee Raise Form | Rev. 2026-09-30

blocks.text: If printed, use black ink. Write dates as MM/DD/YYYY, strike through and initial corrections, and write N/A where a field does not apply. The manager routes the form to the General Manager, then the employee, then HR. The employee signs before the effective date, because that signature date is the pay-change notice.

rows.label: Current base rate ($ per hour or per year)
New base rate ($ per hour or per year)
Effective date (for work on and after)
Reason (describe a promotion or other reason below)

blocks.heading: Terms
items: The new base rate (gross) replaces the rate in Employment Agreement Section 1(b), Wages, for work on and after the effective date, and changes no other term. A promotion also needs a personnel-change document.

If Sales plan participant is Yes, the manager attaches a new Compensation Schedule or an amendment signed by the employee and the General Manager, with the new on-target earnings (OTE) estimate and base rate.

blocks.heading: Signatures

columns.statement: I acknowledge receipt of this notice of my new base rate on the date signed below.

full_rows: If returned: reason (General Manager). The manager resubmits this form; to approve it, strike Returned and initial.
If signed on or after the effective date: date notice was given (manager initials)

blocks.label: HR use only
blocks.statement: Updates the HR database and payroll.
